title: Sugaree Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Walk across the street to the Beach Access - 2 adult beach cruiser bikes -Full mattress sized sleeper sofa - Washer and Dryer - Fully stocked kitchen- great place for monthly stays! - Golf cart friendly rental community - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). Guest cottage to Sugar Magnolia, Sugaree, is a spacious 1 bedroom/ 1 bath cottage located in in a quiet Seagrove neighborhood next to Grove by the Sea on Scenic 30-A. Steps to the beautiful Emerald Coast and a short walk to the town of Seaside, Sugaree is perfectly situated. Nestled among magnolias, live oaks, and bay trees, a fabulous guest cottage awaits you! Sugaree is 616 sq ft with a full kitchen, living room and washer and dryer set up. Awaken to a courtyard garden and open your doors and enjoy your morning coffee on your private deck. The upstairs is a great place to relax and plan your day's activities. Walk or bike to nearby shops and dining in Seagrove, Seaside and Watercolor. Enjoy fishing, stand up Paddle Boarding, Canoeing, and Kayaking, or just kick back and drink in the sunset as you bury your toes in the sand. The tastefully furnished cottage comes with a plush queen size bed to enhance your beach getaway. Beach access is directly across the street. This cottage allows 2-night rentals at various times throughout the year. Inquire about your specific dates. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps up to 4) First Floor :Queen bed, flat screen TV, ensuite full bathroom and W/D 2nd Floor: Sleeper Sofa (full size mattress) with TV, Dining space for 2 and full kitchen. FREE WiFi Must be 25 to Rent Sorry, no pets!
